why: Every entry here is only fixable by a framework major upgrade — expo@57 + react-native@0.72, or next@16 + sharp@0.35 — which is a migration, not a patch. They are all BUILD-TIME tooling reached through metro/expo/next (postcss sourceMappingURL file read, image-size parser DoS), not runtime paths an external caller reaches. Tracked for the framework-upgrade work; the gate fails on anything NOT listed here.
